item.category: Ibanez JEM, UV, JS & Other Signature Models
item.dc:creator: MedJem1
item.content:encoded:
3 necks. 3 vibes. What to do (?)

  • Stock 97 Japan UV777 neck
  • Custom Maple neck
  • Custom Ebony neck

I’m thinking 3 necks, 30 days each = a 90 day trial. Oct Nov Dec. On Jan 1st, reach a verdict.

Force myself not to swap them and play each neck for 30 days straight at a time.

Deciding Factors: Feel, playability, resonance, tone, holding tune, and of course.. looks.

Who will win...

item.title: Tube amp PROBLEM
item.author: invalid@example.com (Tpot)
item.dc:creator: Tpot
item.content:encoded:
Hi,

I have a 4x12” Peavy cabinet with a 6505+ amp head.

I was noticing that the sound coming out of the speaker cabinet was breaking up and crackling at times.

So I decided to get some new TUBES to replace the existing TUBES.

I changed all the TUBES (6L6 and ECC83), although I accidentally purchased one too few ECC83 tubes.

The amps sound has since changed to a PROBLEMATIC SOUND of a LOUD HORN TYPE SOUND!

What trouble shooting advice can you give me that may correct this PROBLEM SOUND...
